chunks: And ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

He was asked about a muḥrim who has a wound and treats it with a medicine containing saffron. He said, “If the saffron is dominant in the medicine, then no; but if the medicines are dominant over it, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of iḥrām

ai.seo_question: Can a muḥrim use medicine containing saffron to treat a wound?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for the muḥrim regarding medicinal treatment containing saffron. It distinguishes between cases where saffron is the dominant ingredient and where it is secondary, permitting the latter and forbidding the former.
